theorem norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem {α y n w G : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 < y) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n y)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y) (hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n)
    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) :=

note: Lean avoids Prop 11.2.3's δ_w = wδ issue by taking a fresh Dirichlet approximation at each scale, and merges cases q ≤ r and q > r. Erratum: (13.14) cites (11.18), whose statement omits the w < 1/K term C_{φ,0,K}y that the proof of Prop 11.2.3 adds (1.46·10⁻⁵y at y = 10²⁵), and it needs g_{y,φ} monotone up to y^{1/3}/6 = 3.59·10⁷, while Lemma 11.2.4 covers only (y/K)^{1/3}/6 = 1.17·10⁷. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_13_14.py`).
